title: Delocalizing a smooth factorization over a localized base
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $A$ an $R$-algebra of finite presentation ($A\cong R[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(g_1,\dots,g_t)$), $\Lambda$ an $R$-algebra and $\alpha:A\to\Lambda$ a homomorphism of $R$-algebras. Let $S\subset R$ be a multiplicative subset, and let $S^{-1}A\xrightarrow{\beta'}B'\xrightarrow{\gamma'}S^{-1}\Lambda$ be homomorphisms of $S^{-1}R$-algebras with $\gamma'\circ\beta'=S^{-1}\alpha$ and $B'$ a smooth $S^{-1}R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. Then there are an $R$-algebra $B$ of finite presentation, homomorphisms of $R$-algebras $A\xrightarrow{\beta}B\xrightarrow{\gamma}\Lambda$ with $\gamma\circ\beta=\alpha$, and an element $s\in S$ whose image in $B$ is elementary standard in $B$ over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-strictly-standard-element].

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07F4 (lemma-delocalize-base, line 1937) and its proof (lines 1946-1997; the ring B constructed there is R[x_1,...,x_{n+m}]/(s'_1f_1,...,s'_cf_c,g_1,...,g_t), of finite presentation); uses Lemma lemma-smooth-standard-smooth and Lemma lemma-standard-smooth-include-generators
